goal: Install Megatron-LM enough that `python tools/preprocess_data.py --input data.jsonl --output-prefix out --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer --tokenizer-model <dir> --workers 2 --append-eod` runs on CPU, where <dir> is a local copy of the GPT-2 tokenizer from Hugging Face (openai-community/gpt2, not gated: config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, vocab.json, merges.txt). The input is a JSONL file with a `text` field per line. It must produce out_text_document.bin and out_text_document.idx, which load with megatron.core.datasets.indexed_dataset.IndexedDataset.
